engagement.note: The replicon copies HCV's own genome in a human hepatoma line.
engagement.short: Replicon copies HCV's genome in human cells

engagement.note: Interferon-α, an approved drug, stopped replication in the replicon.

dose.note: A viral-kinetics model predicted 3-day viral-load drops from replicon potency for one drug class, not another.
dose.short: Predicts 3-day viral drop for one drug class
dose.reason: Predicted 3-day drops for one class only

efficacy.note: Replicon read-out is viral RNA, measured in patients' plasma too; cure is not measurable in the dish.
efficacy.short: Viral RNA read in dish and plasma

efficacy.note: Daclatasvir's picomolar replicon potency matched a 3.3 log10 viral-load drop after one dose; clinical resistance sat at replicon-identified positions.

safety.note: The replicon has no safety read-out; ciluprevir's heart toxicity appeared in monkeys only after human proof of concept.
safety.reason: Heart toxicity found later, in monkeys
